status: Three mockups for discussion; no production layout selected or implemented
audience_priority: General public without Digital Fellows/GCDI/Graduate Center background
Current and former Digital Fellows, alumni and post authors
additional_audiences: Students seeking support and using services
Administrators interested in university mission, identifiable outcomes and deliverables
core_jobs: Explain who the Digital Fellows are and situate the Graduate Center in CUNY
Make Tagging the Tower searchable and navigable
Offer a machine-driven synthesis and interpretation grounded in the authors’ voices
Make data quality and interpretation reviewable by humans in both interface and code
Preserve design history in an optional but discoverable form
evidence_boundaries: No claim that the archive alone establishes program effectiveness or causal university outcomes
A selected 19-post interpretation is not a consensus or the complete 421-post archive
Differentiate guest/participant writing, article authorship and fellowship status at publication
Retain annotated back-end methods, source evidence, CRediT/GAIDeT and unresolved-credit disclosures

options.name: Open library
options.organizing_principle: Search and reading first; a visible invitation to the collective synthesis.
options.public_orientation: A short explanation of CUNY, the Graduate Center and Digital Fellows before search.
options.discovery: Prominent search and Surprise me together; results in the main column.
options.synthesis: A supporting panel introduces the AI-assisted reading and a named source voice.
options.design_history: A small footer disclosure with optional era previews.
options.strength: Fast route into the archive for both newcomers and returning writers.
options.tradeoff: The interpretive project receives less attention than search.

options.name: Collective wisdom
options.organizing_principle: Editorial synthesis first, with the authors’ voices adjacent and archive search in a sidebar.
options.public_orientation: Institutional context precedes the interpretive headline; selection limits are near the claim.
options.discovery: Sidebar search and Meet a random post remain available.
options.synthesis: The main reading experience explicitly labels the AI interpretation and leads to its supporting source.
options.design_history: An editorial interlude, rather than an ever-present appearance studio.
options.strength: Communicates the project’s attempt to synthesize the authors’ collective wisdom.
options.tradeoff: Can privilege the AI’s narrative over direct browsing; source names, passages and limits must remain prominent.

options.name: Welcoming pathways
options.organizing_principle: Introduce the people and institution, then offer three clear tasks: find, discover, interpret.
options.public_orientation: A visible Who are the Digital Fellows? block and plain-language context assume no institutional knowledge.
options.discovery: Separate search/browse and random-discovery actions; sample results directly below.
options.synthesis: A parallel pathway gives the machine-assisted reading equal conceptual standing with archive discovery.
options.design_history: A separate optional exhibit entered from the footer.
options.strength: Strongest newcomer orientation and clearest explanation of what a visitor can do.
options.tradeoff: Introduces an extra choice before the post list and needs a concise introduction to avoid recreating a long landing page.

sample.source: Existing embedded reader-data in the unchanged analysis/index.html
sample.search_scope: Six saved example posts only; explicitly labelled in each mockup
sample.source_authorship: Five source-supported records and one declared-credit record; current canonical display names retained
sample.random_rule: Uniform draw among sample posts excluding the immediately previous random draw in that option
sample.interpretive_example: Maren Rothfritz, post 6755, an explicitly credited participant reflection; excerpt supports a proposed reading about future independence, not a program-wide outcome

validation.markup: Unique element IDs; three named variants; fragment under 1 MB; no network requests in prototype script
validation.browser: Default desktop browser, dark appearance; all three variants inspected and screenshots saved
sample_search: Open library: linked data -> 2 of 6 matches
Collective wisdom: no such example -> 0 of 6 matches
validation.random: Two consecutive Welcoming pathways random draws returned distinct saved post IDs; exclusion is also explicit in source
validation.synthesis: Interpretation panel opens with named Maren Rothfritz source and scope caveat
validation.era_preview: Welcoming pathways selector changes data-era to 2012 and back to 2026
not_verified: Actual user preferences or usability outcomes
Full-archive search or model fitting; these are sample interactions only
Long-term validity of external source URLs
validation.attribution_structure_tests: 4 credits tests and 8 process tests passed
validation.production_preservation: All 799 protected site/evidence file fingerprints unchanged
